scope.title: Turn redacted failure traces into re-runnable eval samples

decision.reason: A pure converter turns one selected redacted failure trace into one re-runnable eval sample (before-fix fail / after-fix pass) with a bounded reproducer + selector + digest; non-redacted traces are refused whole, so a promoted sample cannot leak. Explicit-trigger batch only; no scheduler/daemon.

traceToEval.redactionGate: refuses whole trace on raw prompt/messages/body/authorization/apiKey/headers or sk-/phc_/ghp_/AKIA/private-key
traceToEval.trigger: explicit-trigger batch (selected traces only); no scheduler/daemon

residual.assembly: The converter is provided; wiring it to a concrete trace store / runner is integration-layer work.
residual.scope: No new scenario registry, daemon, or scheduled automation; original evidence is never deleted; no default/lock/approval change.

independentVerification.detail: Tests cover failure/success/refusal/cancelled expected outcomes, the redaction gate (raw prompt and secret-like value), bounded reproducer rejection, explicit-trigger batch rejections, and missing-field rejection. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: A failure trace becomes a sample expected to fail before the fix and pass after; success/refusal/cancelled stay pass.
Reproducer kind is scenario|route|command-id (never shell); selector is runId+attempt; digest is deterministic.
A trace with a raw content field or a secret-like value is refused whole (trace-not-redacted); no sample is written.
traceToEvalSamples converts only selected traces and records per-trace rejections; no scheduler/daemon added.
No product default/lock/approval change; original evidence is not deleted; no new scenario registry.
6 tests pass, typecheck:test 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: Wiring the converter to a concrete trace store/runner.
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
